ceu: ✦ The sextile between Venus and Mars

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, relationships and romance: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. An idea from today could become a real project.
With Mercury retrograde in your intimacy sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Take a deep breath whenever you feel jealousy or distrust.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, routine and family: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
With Venus retrograde in your daily routine sector, review what you value before making choices in love or money.
s.d: Ask the person beside you how you can help.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, romance and conversations: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
With Mercury retrograde in your daily routine sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Get up from your chair every hour and stretch.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, family and money: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
With Venus retrograde in your home and family sector, it is better to adjust what already exists than to start something new.
s.d: Show someone what you have created, without fear of criticism.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, conversations and your image: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
With Mercury retrograde in your home and family sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Offer help to someone in your family without waiting to be asked.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, money and your inner life: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Let things flow without forcing them.
With Venus retrograde in your money sector, people and feelings from the past may become important again.
s.d: Call a brother, sister, cousin or neighbour just to see how they are.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, your image and friendships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
With Mercury retrograde in your money sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Tidy your wallet and your papers: order attracts clarity.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, your inner life and your career: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
With Venus retrograde in your inner life sector, review what you value before making choices in love or money.
s.d: Say no to a request that takes you away from your priorities.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: A day for prayer, meditation or a simple walk on your own. The peace you find today stays with you.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, friendships and your horizons: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
With Mercury retrograde in your inner life sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Settle an old matter before starting something new.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, your career and intimacy: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
With Venus retrograde in your career sector, it is better to adjust what already exists than to start something new.
s.d: Join a group or a conversation about a subject you enjoy.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, your horizons and relationships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
With Mercury retrograde in your career sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Show your work: people who do not show up are not remembered.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, intimacy and routine: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
With Venus retrograde in your intimacy sector, people and feelings from the past may become important again.
s.d: Listen to a podcast or a talk on a new subject.
